body:
rachael: Quick check proposing a tiny onboarding 'mini-banner' that appears above the workspace list for new orgs. It shows: Connect account, Try sample, Run quick tour. Persistent for 3 sessions then collapses. Thoughts?
devin: Love the location, less intrusive than the top nav. But the mock uses 12px text on a pale gray card  contrast will fail for small text.
sam: Agree on contrast. Also need a clear keyboard order and focus-visible styles. If it's per-org, respect admin settings for company-wide hide.
olivia: Copy options: "Get started with Redwood" vs "Try a sample project" vs "Finish onboarding". My vote: "Get started with Redwood"  friendlier.
accessibility-bot: Accessibility checklist: ensure 4.5:1 contrast for body, 3:1 for large text only, focusable elements in tab order, have aria-labels for actions, and an aria-live polite region to announce completion.
devin: UX details: collapse into an icon-only chip on mobile; ensure chip has 44px tap target. Also consider an inline help link "Why this?" explaining data stored locally.
rachael: Dismiss logic: collapse after 3 sessions or when a user explicitly chooses "Don't show again". Also surface a way to bring it back via Help > Onboarding.
sam: Tiny nit on the close button: use aria-label="Dismiss onboarding banner" not just "Close". Also ensure the close is keyboard reachable and announced when used.
olivia: We should A/B test the workflow order. Some users prefer running a quick sample first, others want to connect credentials. Track funnel: onboard_impression -> onboarding_cta_click -> sample_run_or_connect.
rachael: I'll update Figma with high-contrast palette, keyboard flows, and a collapsed mobile chip. Will post frames in #design and schedule a short playtest next week. Thanks! :sparkles:
